decisions.reason: The black-finish range is a low-cost variant of established products, and its move to a dedicated page in 2024 signals growing commitment, so the option is cheap to hold while design-trend demand plays out.
The shower channel for seamless coverings has had its own page in both years and fits the firm's barrier-free bathroom strategy, so it shows a favourable resolution at low carrying cost.

The pump-drain channel launched in 2024 still has unresolved prospects and likely replaces the withdrawn pump solution C, so it is worth holding as the firm's remaining option in pump-assisted drainage despite some risk.
